title: ping_l2 native_sim build blockers: coap_client.c send_mutex drift (and recv_async family)
description: Found while debugging project-LICHEN-worker6-5fva.1 on heft (native_sim/native/64, pinned v3.7.0, main checkout): after fixing coap_status.c (strnlen strict-ISO + conversion), ping_l2 still fails to compile at lichen/subsys/lichen/coap/coap_client.c:181 - 'struct coap_client has no member named send_mutex; did you mean send_buf' - coap_client code drifted from the struct definition (likely coap_server/coap_client refactor). Additionally the recv_async 3-arg (user_data) contract migration tracked in project-LICHEN-worker6-0l5j blocks: lora_l2_rx.c:139,310,380 (2-arg calls + wrong callback signature), lora_loopback.c:239 (cb invoked with too few args), lora_loopback.c:301 (registration function pointer mismatch). ping_l2 runtime diagnosis (-ENOENT from lichen_link_tx) cannot proceed until these compile. Fix send_mutex drift and coordinate the recv_async migration with 0l5j/sb0b.
